testsuite.name: com.geoknoesis.trustweave.saas.server.controller.TenantAdministrationIntegrationTest

testcase.name: group mutations cannot cross tenants or import an outsider()
plain users cannot administer users roles or groups and tenant admins cannot read operations()
display name admin cannot create or rename a privileged realm role()
legacy privileged role ownership cannot authorize a realm role grant or rename()
tenant lists include only owner and members and search never queries or syncs the realm()
all role mutation paths reject foreign resources before Keycloak writes()
tenant admin cannot read or sync another tenant user()
tenant cannot grant built in or composite roles but can grant its own simple role()
